purpose: Machine-readable registry for the no-cost/open validation stack. This is planning/provenance data, not permission to mutate production audio or Serato state.

providers.license_summary: LGPL-2.1-or-later by default; GPL-2.0-or-later applies when optional GPL components are enabled
Current upstream project-authored code is MIT; effective packaged/binary licensing can depend on linked components and build configuration
providers.notes: Chromaprint generates fingerprints for audio identification. A fingerprint or similarity result is evidence, not proof that protected Clean/Dirty/Intro/Outro/Extended/Remix/Edit/Acapella/Instrumental variants are disposable or identical.
Local fingerprinting can be offline; AcoustID lookup through this wrapper requires network access. Convenience only; direct fpcalc + HTTP/JSON must remain possible.

providers.credentials: registered application client key required for lookup
providers.rate_limit: no more than 3 requests per second under the published usage guidelines
providers.data_license_summary: Public fingerprint database CC BY-SA 3.0; MusicBrainz-AcoustID mapping described as public domain
providers.notes: Use lookup only in this project. Provider maintenance/unavailability must surface as a runtime state, never as a successful no-match.

providers.credentials: no API key currently required for normal lookup requests
providers.rate_limit: client applications must not exceed 1 request per second; source IP is also rate-limited around 1 request per second unless separately arranged
providers.notes: A MusicBrainz Recording has title, artist credit, length, ISRCs and relationships, but not a generic recording-date property. Keep earliest release date, release-group first-release date, matched-release date, and any separately sourced performance/recording date distinct.

providers.license_summary: faster-whisper code is MIT; model weights/configuration must be tracked separately with their own source/version/license
providers.notes: Loading a model by Hub name can download it from Hugging Face. For a strict offline run, pre-stage model files and use local-files-only/local-path behavior. Detected reviewed explicit terms can support LIKELY_DIRTY; non-detection never proves CLEAN.
Deliberately excluded from the required free/open validation core.
